description: Rule-level suppressions for the mobile doctor-curated pass. Each entry needs a written reason. For F2a / harness findings, read docs/MOBILE_TEST_AUTOMATION_PRODUCTION_CLEAN.md before escalating.

suppressions.reason: Reachability / unused-file signal is noisy for RN navigation and Ignite-style layout; treat dead-code cleanup as a separate deliberate lot (same posture as Admin UI doctor-curated).
Often flags intentional public module surfaces and generated-adjacent helpers; not a default punctual-hygiene P1.
Dependency graph noise belongs with yarn deps:monitor / a dedicated knip pass, not the default mobile-doctor shortlist.
High-volume Touchable*→Pressable preference (10+ hits on first smoke). Valid improvement as a deliberate UI migration campaign, not default punctual triage noise.
Sequential instance-info refresh is intentional: per-installation fail-open/fail-closed isolation and no Auth API stampede. Not a hot path. Campaign 2026-08-25 pass-1.
Sequential Keystore/seal rehydration isolates MOB-015 broken vs healthy rows. Native crypto is typically serialized; Promise.all would add accidental complexity. Campaign 2026-08-25 pass-1.

RN 0.86.2 already enables transform-runtime. Explicit enableBabelRuntime version string is a compiler hint, not a missing library pin (@babel/runtime is already 8.0.0). Deferred: Babel 8 + Metro is a sensitive surface and there is no measured bundle defect. Campaign 2026-08-25 pass-1.

Stale overlapping loadPendingAttempt is a real pattern but rare (enrollment switch / double refresh). No generation-counter rewrite in the pending-auth path without an observed race. Campaign 2026-08-25 pass-1.

Level 2 policy at respond; keygen securityLevel reserved for deferred MOB-001 Track B; do not wire in hygiene. Live product not broken: ensureEnrollmentKeyPair does not pass securityLevel; keys stay setUserAuthenticationRequired(false). Christophe 2026-09-17; campaign 2026-09-17 pass-1.

SECURITY_LEVEL_CONFIRM_BEFORE_APPROVALS reserved for deferred MOB-001 Track B; Level 2 policy at respond — do not wire in hygiene. Live product not broken. Christophe 2026-09-17; campaign 2026-09-17 pass-1.

EzkeyCryptoErrorCode.verify keeps the iOS EZK_* code table identical to Android's. iOS verify never rejects by design (false on malformed input, XCTest testVerifyNeverRejectsOnMalformedInput); Android's EZK_VERIFY_ERROR branches are effectively unreachable too. Crypto code that works: leave it (pass 2026-11-03 #1).

Codec test helper, called from XCTest only (Periphery does not count the @testable test target as a caller). isLowS checks the low-S boundary and real signatures; flipS builds the high-S malleability case. Kept next to the arithmetic it exercises (pass 2026-11-03 #2).

Codec test helper, called from XCTest only (Periphery does not count the @testable test target as a caller). isLowS checks the low-S boundary and real signatures; flipS builds the high-S malleability case. Kept next to the arithmetic it exercises (pass 2026-11-03 #2).

Vestigial bridge parameter: ignored on Android too (StrongBox first, fallback), never passed by the JS caller (cryptoService.ts); the user security preference applies at approval time (usePendingAuth). Parity holds; no crypto churn (pass 2026-11-03 #3).

React Native promise blocks (RCTPromiseResolveBlock / RCTPromiseRejectBlock) are @escaping by convention; several bridge methods call them asynchronously (signWithAuthentication via queue.async), and dropping @escaping would break the build the day a method goes async (pass 2026-11-03 #4).

Bridge methods that never fail (canUseProtectedSigning, verify: never rejects by design) still need the resolve/reject pair for React Native to expose a promise. Scoped to 'reject' so a future truly unused parameter still shows (pass 2026-11-03 #4).
infoDictionary mirrors Bundle.main.infoDictionary, which is optional, and is injected for tests (pass 2026-11-03 #4).
UIApplicationDelegate signature from the React Native 0.88.1 template (pass 2026-11-03 #4).
launchOptions type is imposed by UIApplicationDelegate (pass 2026-11-03 #4).
UIWindowSceneDelegate signature from the React Native 0.88.1 template (pass 2026-11-03 #4).
XCTest idiom: fixture set in setUp, cleared in tearDown (pass 2026-11-03 #5).
constantsToExport() returns [AnyHashable: Any], which is not Equatable; NSDictionary is how the test compares the dictionary exported to React Native (pass 2026-11-03 #5).
